title: Methylnissolin preserves chondrocyte homeostasis and attenuates experimental osteoarthritis through modulation of the PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB signaling axis.
authors: Zhang, Xiuzhi; Gong, Chaochao; Zhou, Jiale; Zhang, Yu; Jiang, Hongyi; Yang, Yuwen; Huang, Weihao; Chen, Yige; Wang, Ke; Zhao, Youming; Guo, Weijun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Methylnissolin对骨关节炎软骨保护作用，聚焦PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB信号通路，仅用分子对接作辅助靶点预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoarthritis (OA) involves extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation, inflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and chondrocyte loss. Methylnissolin (MN) is a natural isoflavonoid with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, but its effects in OA remain unclear. PURPOSE: To evaluate the chondroprotective effects of MN in experimental OA and examine the involvement of PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB signaling. METHODS: MN was investigated in interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta)-stimulated primary rat chondrocytes and a rat destabilization of the medial meniscus model. ECM metabolism, inflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial function, and apoptosis were assessed using molecular, cellular, and histological methods. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to identify candidate targets and pathways, and the PI3K activator 740Y-P was used for pharmacological reversal experiments. RESULTS: MN reduced IL-1beta-induced ECM catabolism and inflammatory mediator production, decreased intracellular and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species, preserved mitochondrial membrane potential, and inhibited chondrocyte apoptosis. In vivo, MN alleviated cartilage degeneration and improved histological outcomes. Network analysis identified 39 overlapping MN- and OA-related targets and highlighted ECM remodeling and PI3K-AKT-related processes. MN reduced IL-1beta-induced activation of PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB signaling, whereas 740Y-P partially reversed several protective effects. CONCLUSION: MN protects against experimental OA by preserving ECM homeostasis and attenuating inflammatory, oxidative, mitochondrial, and apoptotic injury. These effects are associated, at least in part, with reduced PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB pathway activation, while the computational findings remain hypothesis-generating.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎（OA）涉及细胞外基质（ECM）降解、炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍及软骨细胞丢失。甲基尼索林（MN）是一种天然异黄酮类化合物，具有抗炎和抗氧化特性，但其在OA中的作用尚不明确。目的：评估MN在实验性OA中的软骨保护作用，并探讨PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB信号通路的参与。方法：在白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta）刺激的原代大鼠软骨细胞和大鼠内侧半月板失稳模型中研究MN。通过分子、细胞和组织学方法评估ECM代谢、炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能和凋亡。使用网络药理学和分子对接识别候选靶点和通路，并使用PI3K激活剂740Y-P进行药理学逆转实验。结果：MN减少了IL-1beta诱导的ECM分解代谢和炎症介质产生，降低了细胞内和线粒体活性氧水平，维持了线粒体膜电位，并抑制了软骨细胞凋亡。在体内，MN减轻了软骨退化并改善了组织学结果。网络分析识别出39个MN与OA相关的重叠靶点，并强调了ECM重塑和PI3K-AKT相关过程。MN降低了IL-1beta诱导的PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB信号激活，而740Y-P部分逆转了若干保护效应。结论：MN通过维持ECM稳态并减轻炎症、氧化、线粒体和凋亡损伤，对实验性OA具有保护作用。这些效应至少部分与PI3K-AKT-NF-kappaB通路激活减少相关，而计算发现仍具有假设生成性质。
